text:
Ana (Marketing PM): Quick heads up — we need a short sync on the pricing page experiments: FAQ reshuffle, tier names, and the new estimator flow. thinking a micro-webinar + updated inbound triage playbook. Who's available?

Sam (Growth): +1. Can we scope KPI: signups from calculator -> demo requests? want to track funnel delta.

Lina (Product): Happy to lead the estimator UX requirements. We should standardize tier labels before the webinar.

Beth (Design): I can draft 2 tier naming directions: literal vs benefit-led. Will post comps tomorrow.

Michael (Sales): Sales prefers clearer commit thresholds in tier copy. Hourly calls get messy. Also want template for lead routing by ARR.

Ana (Marketing PM): For inbound triage: propose rules: calculator > 5k ARR -> sales SLA 24h, 1-5k -> AE nurture, <1k -> self-serve drip. Thoughts?

Sam (Growth): Can we make 5k configurable? also add region routing (EU -> EMEA SDR)?

Lina (Product): Yes + we'll surface region in calc. Also capture 'expected monthly tokens' as a field for routing.

Beth (Design): Quick mock: calculator collects company size, expected tokens, region, current infra. Small ask.

ops-bot: Reminder: This thread scheduled as meeting invite on 2024-06-10 10:30 UTC if a calendar event is created.

Ana (Marketing PM): Let's run micro-webinar 6/20. Outline: 15 min why tiers, 15 min demo of estimator, 15 min Q&A. Promo: blog + in-app banner + email.

Sam (Growth): A/B test two call-to-action strings on the pricing page: 'Estimate my cost' vs 'See my plan'. We'll route clicks to different funnels.

Michael (Sales): Need a one-pager for demo handoff with lead priority scores. I can draft.

Lina (Product): Action items: Beth - tier naming comps (tomorrow). Sam - experiment setup (by Friday). Michael - lead routing template (Mon). Ana - webinar landing + promo plan (EOD Friday).

Beth (Design): ack. will add notes on tone (no jargon, focus on unit economics).

Ana (Marketing PM): I'll create the inbound triage playbook doc and post link here when ready.

Sam (Growth): Also a quick note: let's include a baseline benchmark paragraph for the webinar referencing latency/cost savings we've seen with batching — marketing wants a simple stat.

Lina (Product): I'll pull numbers from runtime team and share. probably safe to say 'up to 40% lower per-token cost' with our batching + KV cache on typical app workloads.

Ana (Marketing PM): Perfect. Closing loop — next sync after designs land. Thanks y'all :tada:
